pk.context: 10 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: It targets the intestinal sterol transporter NPC1L1, and its 10 mg tablet is capsule-shaped and debossed with 414.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability cannot be determined, and food does not affect the extent of absorption. More than 90% binds plasma proteins, and most of the dose is recovered in the feces.
Molecular weight 409.4. A crystalline powder, freely to very soluble in ethanol and practically insoluble in water.
Approved under an NDA as a single 10 mg tablet strength.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated in known hypersensitivity to the drug or its excipients; upper respiratory tract infection and diarrhea are among the commonest reactions.
Adjunct to diet to lower elevated LDL cholesterol in primary and mixed hyperlipidemia, alone or with a statin, and in familial hypercholesterolemia.
Targets the sterol transporter NPC1L1 on the brush border of the small intestine, inhibiting cholesterol absorption and increasing LDL receptors.
The generic name begins with E and has nine letters.
